rationale: T0 and T1 are the first writes into the zero-init qubits q7 and q6, so each can be a compute-only clean AND at 4 T. P0 has its controls fixed but its target q8 is written in between, so it uses a temporary AND on a fresh ancilla (4 T for the pair). The remaining in-place Toffolis T3, T4 and T5 use the Jones 4-T route, giving 24 T in total versus 49 naive.
